kind: real owner replay scenario A — Work Result -> Rework -> New Attempt
fixtureAuthorityDetail: The history is produced by the real product machinery (ProjectController, EventStore, the Effects runtime and the governed appendReworkReopening seam). No TrajectoryNode is hand-authored.

positiveRelations.basis: the authorizing event's project_sequence and event_digest

positiveRelations.establishedBy: the attempt report's attempt_id equals the terminal event's entity_id
the promotion names an attempt whose completed result is in this project history
the provenance ref resolves to an ATTEMPT_COMPLETED event in the same project
parent_revision resolves to an event carrying that revision in this cut

historicalAuthorizationPreserved.mechanism: A0's authorization is resolved from A0's OWN ATTEMPT_CREATED.payload.envelope_id and the TASK_CREATED/TASK_REAUTHORIZED event carrying that envelope — never from the task's current row.
historicalAuthorizationPreserved.measuredBy: §6: a LATER change to the task's current envelope row does not rebind A0's historical authorization (the compared envelopeId is unchanged).

asOfCut.verifiedBy: a cut taken at the governed TASK_READY sequence contains no A1 ATTEMPT_CREATED node, and rebuilding the same cut yields the same semantic digest

negativeControls.invalidRelation: A0's authorization replaced with the current Task Envelope
negativeControls.refused: UNRESOLVED_SOURCE edge + an unresolved reference entry
negativeControls.reason: no TASK_CREATED/TASK_REAUTHORIZED event in this project carries the rebound envelope_id
the event's project_id differs from the requested project

negativeControls.invalidRelation: a forged Rework relation without the governed TASK_READY provenance
negativeControls.refused: no ATTEMPT_REOPENED_FOR_REWORK edge is produced at all
negativeControls.reason: with no rework_provenance there is no source for the relation, so it cannot be invented

negativeControls.invalidRelation: removal of the event a relation depends on
negativeControls.refused: RESULT_PROMOTED edge degrades to UNRESOLVED_SOURCE with evidence null
negativeControls.reason: the promoted attempt's completed result is absent from the history

negativeControls.invalidRelation: a mutated payload without an updated digest
negativeControls.reason: parseSchedulerEvent recomputed the digest and it disagreed
the event does not link to the prior event digest

negativeControls.invalidRelation: a causation reference to a later event
negativeControls.reason: the cited event is neither already walked nor below the interval start

negativeControls.invalidRelation: a stale/missing World Basis presented as current
negativeControls.refused: the world component is EMPTY with basisDigest null; the attempt's result is still reported from the Work owner
negativeControls.reason: no recorded basis exists, so an explicit absence is recorded rather than a pass
